notes: Scout and the 27B decider load Qwen3.8-27B (MLX 4-bit in Bionic, model key qwen/qwen3.8-27b, about 16 GB plus cache); on a 64 GB machine enable them only when other large models are unloaded. Hermes members answer with no tools by default (toolsets 'clarify', which Hermes switches off in one-shot mode). Give a member a tool only when its job needs one, by naming the toolset on that member, for example "toolsets": "web"; "toolsets": null uses the profile's own pruned set. Measured on the local 27B: a scout allowed the web tool took 97 s and searched although the prompt says to judge only the facts given; tool-free it takes 25-55 s. model_label, unseen_after and unseen_after_source say which model a member is and what it cannot remember. model_label is the exact model (a tag with its digest, or a version); a member with a model and no model_label is recorded under its model. unseen_after is an ISO date, the model's public release date or later, after which the model certainly cannot have seen a market; unseen_after_source says where that date comes from. null means nothing is certainly unseen, so the tournament scores every blind-history answer of that member as possibly remembered, never as evidence. The owner fills these from a source; no date is guessed.
